'''2018 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event, 4–6 May 2018. [[Lenny Rubin]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Dates:''' 4–6 May 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Lenny Rubin]]
